definitions.gloss: leaving something in a state (and not dealing with it)
definitions.explanation: Attached to the masu-stem of a verb: the action was done and then left that way, usually when it should have been undone or finished (a door left open, a light left on). Often critical.

definitions.gloss: (doing) all the time; without a break
definitions.explanation: The same state or action continues the whole time: standing all day, losing every game.

examples.japanese: ⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開|あ}け→開ける：00563_akeru⟧っぱなしだ。
examples.english: The window has been left open.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電気|でんき}→電気：09780_denki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つけっぱなし⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{寝|ね}て→寝る：00470_neru⟧しまった。
examples.english: I fell asleep with the light on.

examples.japanese: ⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}し→出す：01087_dasu⟧っぱなしにしないで、⟦ちゃんと→ちゃんと：02359_chanto⟧⟦{止|と}めて→止める：00678_tomeru⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
examples.english: Don't leave the water running; turn it off properly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一日中|いちにちじゅう}→一日中：09519_ichinichijuu⟧⟦{立|た}ち→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧っぱなしだった。
examples.english: I was on my feet all day.

examples.japanese: うち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{今季|こんき}→今季：31605_konki⟧⟦{負|ま}け→負ける：01134_makeru⟧っぱなしだ。
examples.english: Our team has lost every game this season.

examples.japanese: ⟦{満員電車|まんいんでんしゃ}→満員電車：08350_manindensha⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{一時間|いちじかん}→一時間：00941_ichijikan⟧⟦{立|た}ち→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧っぱなしだった⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧。
examples.english: My feet hurt after standing for an hour on a packed train.

notes:
From ⟦{放|はな}す→放す：29986_hanasu⟧ (to let go): the っ is the small tsu that joins it to the stem. Also written 〜っ{放|ぱな}し. Used as a noun (〜っぱなしだ), with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (〜っぱなし⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧, to leave as is) and with で (〜っぱなしで, while leaving it so).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{開|あ}け→開ける：00563_akeru⟧っぱなし: left open
- つけっぱなし: left on (a light, TV)
- ⟦{出|だ}し→出す：01087_dasu⟧っぱなし: left out; left running (water)
- ⟦{言|い}い→言う：00515_iu⟧っぱなし: saying something and not following up
- ⟦{立|た}ち→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧っぱなし: standing the whole time

SIMILAR WORDS:
- 〜たまま: in the state of having done; neutral, while 〜っぱなし usually suggests something left undone or overdone
